FROM IDEA TO ACTION

Your story, in three little steps.

  1. Draw your world. Pick Draw or Line, an ink color, and a brush size.
  2. Meet your character. Add a stick figure. Use Move to drag its body, hands, and feet.
  3. Make it move. Press Record and puppet your character. Stop, replay, or scrub your take, then export a video.

Recording replaces the previous take. Backgrounds stay still while your characters move. Use arrow keys to move the selected character.
